text:
maya: sharing an alternate compact Variant Inspector mock that keeps table density but surfaces metrics on focus. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-variant-inspector
maya: Key changes: metric badges hidden by default, appear on hover/focus with non-layout animation; keyboard focus target increased; SR hint added; tooltip copy updated.
sam: Nice direction. Quick thought: if badges are hidden by default, how do we surface that there are metrics without hovering? We should add a subtle affordance (dot or chevron) so users scanning can see something's there.
jing: +1 on affordance. Also recommend 44px min tappable area for touch and increased vertical padding in compact rows. Current mock is 28px which is painful on trackpads/tablets.
alex: Performance: avoid mounting heavy chart components until the inspector opens. Render a lightweight placeholder badge and lazy-load the chart on open. Use requestIdleCallback for non-blocking work.
len: Accessibility: ensure focus order is logical. If focus lands on the row, pressing Enter should open the inspector; but Tab should also allow focusing the 'View metrics' affordance directly. Add aria-controls and aria-expanded states.
sam: Microcopy: prefer 'View metrics' over 'Show metrics' because it's an action that leads to a panel. Also for tooltip we can show small hint: 'View metrics — Enter'. Keep it short.
jing: Contrast nit: the gray badge text is 4.2:1. Because badges are small, aim for >=4.5:1. Either darken text to #1F2937 or use bolder weight + 1px outline.
alex: Motion: use transform + opacity so we don't trigger reflow. For large catalogs (500+ rows) we should virtualize rows; otherwise focus jumps will be janky. Add a class-based reveal to ensure GPU compositing.
QA-Bot: Note: Automated keyboard navigation tests failing on staging build 2026-03-20. Repro steps attached in CI. https://ci.example.com/job/keyboard-tests/342
maya: Thanks. I'll update mock: add visible affordance (small chevron), expand hit target to 44px, switch badge animation to transform+opacity, change copy to 'View metrics', add SR hint 'Press Enter to open Variant Inspector'. I'll also add aria-controls/expanded. Will upload new figma and a staging build link when ready.
sam: Please also include a quick screenshot of contrast tokens used and the accessibility label strings in the PR so QA can run the checks faster.
jing: I'll follow up with a CSS snippet for the hit area and contrast examples.
maya: plan: iterate tonight, push preview tomorrow morning, ping channel. Thanks all :rocket:
